prior_baseline.scope: Repository audit only; not candidate acceptance evidence

run_record_fields.status: pass, fail, blocked, or reviewed not_applicable
run_record_fields.notes: failure, blockage, scope, or retry explanation

rules: This file records results; it does not execute product tests.
Do not mark an aggregate test pass until every required subcase and applicable supported cohort has evidence.
Retain every attempt; a retry does not erase a prior failure.
Missing, blocked, not-run, or failed required cases prevent the affected completion gate.
Not-applicable needs a reviewer and a support-scope rationale; it cannot waive required physical/newcomer/core coverage.
Historical baseline evidence never counts as passing a new candidate.
Thresholds and comparison conditions must be frozen before execution.

tests.procedure: A newcomer chooses a path for a preinstalled unit, own Pi with browser, own Pi with local raw output, and remote application.
tests.expected_result: Each scenario reaches the appropriate path; minimal omissions are visible before installation.

tests.procedure: Follow full setup on a freshly flashed supported Pi using only the user guide; include one reboot and a depth/validity reader.
tests.expected_result: Console loads, readiness is explained, fresh paired output advances, and the frame metadata identifies the actual profile and authority.
tests.required_evidence: Screen recording, sanitized transcript, frame metadata.

tests.procedure: Follow minimal setup from an SSH-ready supported Pi and capture a float-depth frame.
tests.expected_result: Depth, validity, and metadata files are created with documented dimensions/units; the guide never asks for a browser or network SDK.

tests.procedure: Disable mDNS resolution, then follow the documented IP fallback and certificate instructions.
tests.expected_result: The user reaches the correct device and verifies its identity; any certificate hostname mismatch has a supported resolution without disabling TLS checks in SDK code.

tests.procedure: Begin from an unsupported OS/kernel, one missing camera, and an interrupted install in separate trials.
tests.expected_result: Instructions identify the condition, state a specific recovery step, and never report successful capture or metric accuracy.

tests.procedure: Observe five first-time users: two preinstalled, two own-Pi full, and one SDK integration. Supply working supported hardware, approved OS where applicable, internet, and trusted setup material.
tests.expected_result: All five finish their assigned first-frame task without maintainer hints. Active task-time targets: 15 minutes preinstalled, 30 minutes own-Pi full, 15 minutes SDK. Report total time separately; physical assembly, OS flashing, and new calibration acquisition are outside these timed tasks.
tests.required_evidence: Individual task forms, timings, interventions, observed frame identity.

tests.procedure: Render/check current instructions for full and minimal using the approved public-install metadata.
tests.expected_result: Every current install command names the approved published tag and the correct signed profile asset; source-checkout instructions still require an explicit release where appropriate.

tests.procedure: Add a future unpublished development version to a fixture without changing public-install metadata.
tests.expected_result: Current user commands remain pinned to the approved public preview. Missing/invalid public metadata causes an actionable check failure.

tests.procedure: Compare OS/kernel and starting-profile instructions with platform metadata and the authoritative profile catalog.
tests.expected_result: Values agree; all rate claims retain their qualification labels and targets remain labeled as targets.

tests.procedure: Walk through current browser and SDK connection guidance.
tests.expected_result: Browser users are not asked to claim/login; SDK token exchange remains documented and functional; terminology distinguishes hotspot, SSH, and SDK credentials.
tests.required_evidence: Copy review and SDK connection smoke result.

tests.procedure: Compare historical reports before and after rendering/checking current documentation.
tests.expected_result: Historical version references, evidence, commands, and measurements remain unchanged.

tests.procedure: Open published wiki pages and their linked current instructions after update; exercise documentation-only CI.
tests.expected_result: The served pages agree with the repository and links resolve. Only lightweight checks run; ARM64 packaging/signing is not dispatched.

tests.procedure: Exercise accepted, preview, needed, unavailable, malformed, and stale state fixtures.
tests.expected_result: Every interface derives the correct state/reason/action; unknown/error never becomes accepted or silently provisional.

tests.procedure: Install full with accepted calibration, explicit preview, deferred calibration, and custom hardware; reinstall existing units.
tests.expected_result: Capture policy matches the selection; preview is opt-in; existing identities/configuration are preserved; custom hardware stays deferred.

tests.procedure: Import a valid matching user bundle on full and minimal with a real reader subscribed.
tests.expected_result: The active daemon and fresh frame identify the expected bundle/hash and authority; state survives restart.

tests.procedure: Dry-run a valid bundle and invalid identity, camera, profile, geometry, hash, missing-file, and path/symlink fixtures.
tests.expected_result: Valid dry-run makes no persistent/runtime change; incompatible or unsafe input is rejected before activation with a specific reason.

tests.procedure: Test trusted, unknown-key, invalid-signature, and unsigned factory bundles, plus valid user bundles.
tests.expected_result: Factory authority requires the existing factory trust rules; no invalid bundle is accepted or silently relabeled as user validated.

tests.procedure: Interrupt activation at durable transaction boundaries; run concurrent import/rollback attempts.
tests.expected_result: Locking prevents mixed state; restart/recovery loads the last committed valid selection and records a clear failure or pending result.

tests.procedure: Force daemon startup failure or expected-hash mismatch after staging; invoke rollback after a successful import.
tests.expected_result: Failed activation restores the previous selection; explicit rollback loads that selection and its matching frame identity when hardware is available.

tests.procedure: Import/activate while capture is idle, then connect a reader; separately disconnect a camera.
tests.expected_result: Demand-driven idleness is explained, fresh output verifies activation on request, and camera failure remains distinct from calibration status.

tests.procedure: Upgrade/reinstall existing full and minimal fixtures and inspect minimal package dependencies/payload.
tests.expected_result: Existing CLI/bundle formats work; configuration and identity persist; minimal adds no web, SDK, Wi-Fi onboarding, solver, NumPy, or Python OpenCV.

tests.procedure: Review calibration wording and perform a newcomer calibration-readiness task.
tests.expected_result: The user identifies preview versus accepted calibration and its next action; no label claims independent metric accuracy without the corresponding evidence.
tests.required_evidence: Copy review and observed task result.

tests.procedure: Follow the quickstart in clean Linux and Windows client environments using Python 3.11 and one newer recorded supported version.
tests.expected_result: The documented installation/import and first frame succeed with only declared dependencies and trusted device access.

tests.procedure: Connect to real TLS fixtures using the correct certificate, unknown certificate, wrong hostname, and changed device fingerprint.
tests.expected_result: Valid identity succeeds; untrusted/mismatched identity fails with useful guidance; no example bypasses verification.

tests.procedure: Try valid, invalid, absent, and expired SDK credentials; compare automatic browser connection.
tests.expected_result: Authentication failures explain the correct SDK recovery; browser instructions remain accurate; errors and logs contain no token.

tests.procedure: Run every Python example against the matching device and replay fixture. Include valid and invalid pixels and product format variants.
tests.expected_result: Examples handle units, masks, NaNs, dimensions, and authority correctly; recorded expected results match within declared tolerances.
tests.required_evidence: Example outputs and decoded fixture checks.

tests.procedure: Record a finite stream; inject disconnect, timeout, early peer close, and interruption. Replay the completed portion.
tests.expected_result: Finite shortfall fails clearly; complete records remain readable; no silent gap-filling or reconnection changes the recording contract.

tests.procedure: Request disabled raw output, disabled monitoring output, and a subscription exceeding the available link budget.
tests.expected_result: The error names the cause and supported action; the bounded client does not hang or accumulate an unbounded queue.

tests.procedure: Compile/run the C example against installed headers/libraries; read public API/status instructions.
tests.expected_result: No private headers or repository-relative build paths are required; ROS 2 maturity is explicit.

tests.procedure: Exercise documented previous-compatible SDK calls and older supported recordings against the candidate.
tests.expected_result: Existing signatures, frame interpretation, bounded reads, and explicit close/error behavior remain compatible; supported version combinations are recorded.

tests.procedure: Inject missing camera, unsupported kernel, unavailable trigger, failed service, missing calibration, and unavailable network in isolated fixtures.
tests.expected_result: Each condition gets the correct check/reason/action; unavailable data is unknown rather than pass.

tests.procedure: Check healthy idle capture, image-only consumers, disabled optional encoder, and minimal installation.
tests.expected_result: Intentional inactivity/omissions are explained without false faults or suggestions to use absent features.

tests.procedure: Run diagnostics and export on a configured device while hashing persistent configuration, identities, network state, and active selection.
tests.expected_result: Read-only operations leave persistent settings and active service policy unchanged.

tests.procedure: Seed all known secret classes into diagnostic inputs and failure paths; export through CLI/browser and inspect errors.
tests.expected_result: Secret values and private fields are absent; supported allowlisted fields remain usable; output matches the declared schema.
tests.required_evidence: Redaction tests and inspected sample export.

tests.procedure: Reinstall and upgrade an explicitly supported previous signed cohort to the candidate on full and minimal.
tests.expected_result: Identity, calibration, user settings, network choice, and recordings persist; dpkg audit is clean and fresh output returns.

tests.procedure: Select tampered signatures, corrupted assets, mixed cohorts, full/minimal conflicts, and an implicit downgrade.
tests.expected_result: The operation rejects the unsupported transition before replacing the working Nuvo cohort; actionable guidance is shown.

tests.procedure: Interrupt download and package/service work at supported recovery points; follow the documented retry procedure.
tests.expected_result: Partial downloads are not accepted; retry preserves unit state and restores a working supported installation or names the exact unresolved OS/package repair.

tests.procedure: Open Software update on a device with/without reachable release information and follow its terminal procedure.
tests.expected_result: Installed version remains accurate, unverified availability is labeled, commands are pinned, and the page never implies an implemented browser updater or untested rollback.

tests.procedure: Start a clean supported Linux environment, run only the documented minimal bootstrap and build/test commands.
tests.expected_result: Configure, build, and every applicable registered test pass without hidden local dependencies.

tests.procedure: Repeat using the full host environment, including Boost.System, OpenSSL, OpenCV, yaml-cpp, and FFmpeg dependencies.
tests.expected_result: development-full configures/builds/tests successfully; optional omissions and skips are explicit.
tests.required_evidence: Dependency manifest and full test report.

tests.procedure: Run the documented minimum CMake and one newer supported version; try a version below minimum.
tests.expected_result: Supported versions parse/build correctly; unsupported versions fail with a clear requirement.

tests.procedure: Follow supported WSL instructions from a clean documented distribution.
tests.expected_result: Host builds and fixtures work; native Windows/client guidance and physical Pi tasks are clearly distinguished.

tests.procedure: Launch the deterministic gateway/frame fixture, then run browser and SDK integration tests.
tests.expected_result: The actual wire/API contracts are exercised with reproducible identities and labeled fixture output.

tests.procedure: Rebuild the environment from declared inputs on another clean runner.
tests.expected_result: Dependency resolution is reproducible to the declared version policy; no credentials, private datasets, or developer-local paths are required.

tests.procedure: Exercise the PR workflow with deliberate native, SDK, and UI regressions in disposable fixtures.
tests.expected_result: The relevant required job fails; logs identify the failure; skipped/missing required jobs cannot look green.

tests.procedure: Change only user documentation, then change runtime/UI code in separate trials.
tests.expected_result: Docs run lightweight consistency/link checks only; code runs relevant host/browser coverage. ARM64 packaging/signing remains deliberately dispatched.

tests.procedure: Run rendered-browser scenarios for connect, calibration states, stale/unavailable health, form validation, revision conflicts, output selection, restart/reconnect, and diagnostics.
tests.expected_result: Correct actions/messages appear, pending edits are protected, and no unhandled error blocks the task; screenshots/traces are retained on failure.

tests.procedure: Install each profile from frozen candidate artifacts on a newly flashed supported image using physical cameras.
tests.expected_result: Signed-path verification succeeds where applicable; fresh output and correct authority return after required reboot; exact environment/artifact identity is retained.
tests.required_evidence: Physical install, frame, and package reports.

tests.procedure: Perform ten graceful reboot cycles and five physical power-cycle tests per profile; include a controlled interrupted activation/recovery case on a recoverable test device.
tests.expected_result: Identity/configuration/committed calibration survive; services recover according to policy; fresh frames return with a new run identity; no mixed committed state.
tests.required_evidence: Cycle records, state hashes, recovery evidence.

tests.procedure: Exercise Ethernet and twenty setup Wi-Fi handoffs covering success, wrong credentials, missed confirmation, reboot during handoff, and outage after confirmed setup.
tests.expected_result: Confirmed setup persists; failed/unconfirmed setup returns to the protected hotspot with the same secret; an ordinary confirmed-network outage does not reopen it.

tests.procedure: Run the retained advertised workload on every claimed physical Pi RAM SKU/profile combination.
tests.expected_result: Each retained claim has physical evidence; unsupported combinations are removed or clearly marked unqualified before completion.

tests.procedure: Assemble the final candidate report and compare every artifact/hash with the tested manifest.
tests.expected_result: Every required test has valid candidate evidence; failure, blocked, skipped, or not-run cases remain visible and prevent the affected completion gate.
tests.required_evidence: Signed/reviewed completion report and evidence index.

tests.procedure: Subscribe to image-only, depth/validity, preview-only, combined, and zero-consumer cases.
tests.expected_result: Only demanded stages run; idle matcher/encoder work remains idle as appropriate; selected products share capture identity.
tests.required_evidence: Stage counters, CPU and frame trace.

tests.procedure: Measure full/minimal core depth, mixed preview, and multiple bounded clients against the frozen baseline.
tests.expected_result: Regression budgets pass without changing matcher quality, calibration, geometry, or consumer demands to hide cost.

tests.procedure: Sweep admitted and excessive product/cadence requests across measured Ethernet/Wi-Fi budgets.
tests.expected_result: Requests are admitted/rejected according to policy; exact requests are not silently degraded; best-effort gaps/cadence are explained accurately.

tests.procedure: Run slow/stalled clients, disconnect/reconnect, and retained-frame consumers through the 60-minute soak.
tests.expected_result: Queues/ownership remain bounded; retained data stays immutable; no sustained RSS growth, swapping, crash, or new core error occurs.

tests.procedure: Compare displayed capture, depth completion, receive rate, freshness, and latency with independent observations.
tests.expected_result: Labels correspond to their actual measurement boundaries and tolerances; no stale or image-only output inflates depth performance.

tests.procedure: Process a fixed recorded stereo fixture with identical algorithms/controls before and after the changes.
tests.expected_result: Disparity/depth/validity and calibration interpretation meet the frozen equivalence tolerances; user-experience work introduces no hidden quality change.

tests.procedure: Review every retained rate/accuracy/range/RAM claim against candidate evidence; independently measure accuracy if new metric claims are proposed.
tests.expected_result: Claims stay within measured scope. New accuracy claims require predeclared distance/scene/coverage, bias, and RMSE limits and independent ground truth; otherwise existing provisional labels remain.
tests.required_evidence: Claim-to-evidence table and applicable accuracy report.

tests.procedure: Run all applicable existing and new native/Python/JavaScript tests for minimal-host, development-full, and both ARM64 package profiles.
tests.expected_result: All required registered tests pass. Any removed test has a reviewed replacement/rationale; optional skips name the missing capability and cannot satisfy a required gate.

tests.procedure: Exercise local IPC, C ABI, HTTPS snapshot, WebSocket, NUV/NVE decoding, and NVR recording/replay with current and documented compatible clients.
tests.expected_result: Public structures/formats and supported old recordings remain compatible; malformed/bounded input checks continue to reject invalid data.

tests.procedure: Inspect associated frames across concurrency, overload, reconnect, and daemon restart.
tests.expected_result: Products share the expected device/run/capture identity; streamed frames have no unintended duplicate or reversed identity within a run; whole-frame gaps are reported where best effort permits them. Repeated latest snapshots retain their existing allowed semantics.

tests.procedure: Apply valid/invalid exposure, stereo, and encoding settings, including simultaneous edits and formatting-only rewrites.
tests.expected_result: Revision preconditions protect newer edits; atomic writes retain the last valid config; requested/saved/applied are distinct and frame epochs remain correct.

tests.procedure: Exercise TLS, origin/CSRF/session, permissions, calibration trust, and command allowlists around changed paths.
tests.expected_result: Existing protections remain effective; the gateway gains no general root/camera access; diagnostic and error paths expose no secrets.

tests.procedure: Install/reinstall/upgrade/remove the packages in disposable supported environments and inspect artifacts.
tests.expected_result: Package metadata/cohorts are consistent, dependency isolation holds, identity/calibration/recordings are preserved by supported operations, and dpkg audit is clean.

tests.procedure: Test protected hotspot, new-path confirmation/rollback, confirmed outages, and existing SSH/network preservation.
tests.expected_result: Existing network policy and recovery behavior remain compatible; no repair/check silently replaces network configuration.

tests.procedure: Exercise interrupt/crash/low-space/malformed-state cases in durable configuration, calibration, and recording operations.
tests.expected_result: The last committed valid state survives, incomplete output is handled by the existing contract, and failure is explicit without false success.

tests.procedure: Run browser tasks at desktop and 390-pixel mobile widths, keyboard-only navigation, and light/dark themes in recorded supported browser versions.
tests.expected_result: Required controls/actions remain reachable, focus and error messages are usable, text is readable, and no blocker/uncaught error prevents completion.
tests.required_evidence: Browser screenshots and accessibility task checklist.

tests.procedure: Verify repository/export hygiene, workflow permissions, release routing, and protected test-device restoration.
tests.expected_result: No private/generated junk enters source bundles; docs do not trigger signing/builds; test changes restore protected host state; public release actions follow repository policy.
